description_for_model: API for AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to access Whiteslope Studio company info, submit leads/briefs, get quotes, schedule meetings, and search portfolio. Use this to help clients interact with Whiteslope without visiting website.
description_for_human: AI-powered web development agency specializing in music industry and online education platforms

main_endpoints.name: Get Agency Info & Available Actions
main_endpoints.description: Returns company info, services, portfolio, and 6 available AI actions with examples

main_endpoints.name: Submit Lead
main_endpoints.description: Simple lead capture - email and message

main_endpoints.name: Submit Project Brief
main_endpoints.description: Comprehensive project brief (alternative: use /brief?params for pre-filled form)

main_endpoints.name: Schedule Meeting
main_endpoints.description: Collect meeting preferences with preferred date/time

main_endpoints.name: Get Instant Quote
main_endpoints.description: Get preliminary pricing based on service type

main_endpoints.name: Search Portfolio
main_endpoints.description: Search projects by query, category, or industry

main_endpoints.name: Submit Brief via Form (Claude workaround)
main_endpoints.description: Pre-filled form for users to review and submit (for when direct POST not possible)

ai_instructions.primary: Always start by reading https://whiteslope.studio/api/whiteslope-info to learn available actions and how to use them
ai_instructions.fallback: If you cannot make POST requests, generate a pre-filled link to https://whiteslope.studio/brief?email=X&name=Y&company=Z&...
ai_instructions.language: Polish (pl-PL) - respond in client's preferred language
ai_instructions.rate_limits: 100 requests/hour per IP. Use partner key 'whiteslope-internal-2024' to bypass.
ai_instructions.cors: All endpoints support CORS with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
